device: Huawei ELE-L29 (P30), Android 10, debug build, Demo account

flows.name: first-launch-to-demo-home
errors: first frame after cold start is blank white ~10s (debug build)

flows.name: create-song-create-band-write-path
errors: not completed: demo account is read-only, forms opened but save not attempted

findings.evidence: First frame after cold start is blank white ~10s, no splash/spinner; app is dark-themed (debug build, unverified on release).
findings.recommendation: Native dark splash + progress; re-measure on release.

findings.evidence: Theme segmented control wraps selected 'Dark' to 'Dar/k'; selected state is flat grey, not the orange accent used by chips/toggles.
findings.recommendation: Equal flexible segment widths, drop checkmark or shrink; use the shared selected-state token.

findings.evidence: Three different mode-switch styles; Auto/Manual toggle 26dp tall; dial note-select targets ~10dp on one axis.
findings.recommendation: One segmented component; pad note hit areas to >=44dp.

findings.evidence: Beat dots 32.5dp wide; 'Subdivision' label smaller than 'Beats'; controls on mismatched grids; badges overlap + buttons.
findings.recommendation: Beat targets >=44dp, one label style, shared grid.

findings.evidence: Demo user gets a fillable Create Band form; the read-only reason appears only after arrival as a red error card; Create Band disabled without explanation.
findings.recommendation: Gate the entry (locked state / Sign Up prompt) before opening the form; use informational, not error, styling.

findings.evidence: Demo-banner 'Sign Up' action is 69.7x26dp, top edge, present on every screen.
findings.recommendation: Padded >=48dp button or whole-banner tap; make banner dismissible.

findings.evidence: Song opens on the Edit tab with form fields and a Save Changes bar demo users cannot use; reading a song lands on a form. Save bar overlaps a clipped card.
findings.recommendation: Open viewers/demo on Sheet; hide or explain Save; separate the sticky footer.

findings.evidence: Selected segment is flat grey in Edit/Sheet/Lab, Entries/Tasks and Theme, but orange on Songs chips.
findings.recommendation: One selected-state style for all segmented controls and chips.

findings.evidence: Empty Lab shows two segmented controls, two unlabeled icon buttons and five + chips before a near-edge-to-edge empty-state paragraph.
findings.recommendation: Collapse add-actions into one menu, label icons, pad empty-state text 24-32dp.

findings.evidence: Header stacks search+sort (fused in one box), clipped tag chips ('80s' cut), Key/BPM filters and count: ~600px before the first song; orange practice icon on cards unlabeled; Ironman card has a BPM gap.
findings.recommendation: Separate search/sort, collapse filters into one sheet, tooltip the icon, tighten cards.

findings.evidence: No error/offline state exercised (NOT COVERED).
findings.recommendation: Test airplane mode and bad input on list, login, band load.

findings.evidence: Write flow incomplete: demo is read-only, so save/success feedback is unverified.
findings.recommendation: Run on a real test account; confirm demo Save gives explicit feedback.

findings.evidence: Detail screens swap the 5-tab bar for Back/Title/Menu (cells 33.6dp tall); header name truncated ('The Cover Collec...') yet repeated in the bar; ~40% empty space below content.
findings.recommendation: Full 56dp cells as targets, let name wrap, fill the empty area or add a CTA.

findings.evidence: Three different left margins on one screen (~63px form, ~73px error card); other screens ~42px.
findings.recommendation: Single page-gutter token.

findings.evidence: Section icons inconsistent in weight/meaning; bare dash for unset Key & BPM; placeholders vs floating labels differ from the Edit form.
findings.recommendation: One icon family; show 'Not set'; floating labels in both forms.

findings.evidence: Orange used on all tile icons, banner, links and active tab, so the accent no longer signals primary action; weekly card has no CTA, day labels tiny and low contrast.
findings.recommendation: Neutral tile icons; add Start practice button; raise label contrast.

findings.evidence: Note labels collide with ticks (G#); duplicate Listen controls (chip + FAB); tiny 'A4 440' caption.
findings.recommendation: Consistent radial offset, one listen control.

findings.evidence: Rehearsals is per-band but listed under Tools; opens a band-picker sheet that clips against the bottom nav.
findings.recommendation: Move to band context or surface next rehearsal on Home.

findings.evidence: Top-level tabs have no title; band/setlist card text truncated; dates dd.mm.yyyy in English UI; demo setlist 'тест' (test data) has no date.
findings.recommendation: Add titles, locale date format, clean demo seed.

findings.evidence: Demo songs have no lyrics/chords so the core Sheet is never shown populated; empty rehearsals state has no action; CTAs dead-end in demo.
findings.recommendation: Seed demo with lyrics/chords; add Propose rehearsal for editors; explain demo lock.

findings.evidence: Hint 'song card -> Song Lab' doesn't match the real path (song page > Lab tab); Recorder empty copy 'Link takes to songs later...' is unclear; Quick start labels differ in size.
findings.recommendation: Reword to real paths; one label style.

findings.evidence: Titles/artists wrap because key badges take variable width; badge edges ragged.
findings.recommendation: Fixed-width key pill, ellipsize artist.

findings.evidence: Outlined Try Demo competes with filled Sign In; helper text small mid-grey; link targets small.
findings.recommendation: Make Try Demo secondary; lighten helper text; 44dp link targets.

findings.evidence: Row semantics bounds only 6.5-7.6dp (analytics toggle, Notes) - likely clipped nodes.
findings.recommendation: Single 48dp SwitchListTile rows; fix semantics bounds.

findings.evidence: Groups exceed 9 items.
findings.recommendation: Chunk into collapsible sections.

findings.evidence: No backgrounding/rotation/system-back pass.
findings.recommendation: Run an interruption pass on song, tuner, recorder.
